description: Opt-in auto-merge preset, extended as github>jdwlabs/.github:automerge alongside the default preset.

It is deliberately not part of default.json. In a GitOps repository merging is deploying, and a blanket rule would reach every image and chart that repository does not explicitly exclude -- an unattended pod recreation is what cost world data on 2026-08-30. Repositories where a merge only changes their own build opt in; deployment repositories keep writing their own narrow rules.

Merging is armed through GitHub's native auto-merge (platformAutomerge), so a PR still has to pass every required check before it lands; a red build simply stays open. The repository must have allow_auto_merge enabled or nothing ever arms, silently.

packageRules.description: Non-major updates, including the weekly grouped PR and any security fix of that size.

Majors to development dependencies. They cannot reach a user: the blast radius is this repository's own build, which is exactly what the required checks exercise. A dev major that breaks something fails those checks and stays open for a human. Runtime majors are where a dependency may break its contract with callers, so they always wait for review.
